+# API keys
+
+Organization API keys authenticate the public API and the MCP server.
+
+```text
+px1k_<installation id>_<key id>_<secret>
+```
+
+- **The prefix** `px1k_` makes leaked keys easy to match in secret scanners.
+- **The installation and key IDs are not secret.** The server sets
+  `px1.installation_id` from the token before reading anything, so the
+  `api_keys` table stays under the same forced row-level security as every
+  other tenant table. Leaking an installation ID grants nothing.
+- **The secret** is 256 random bits. Only its SHA-256 digest is stored and
+  compared in constant time. A slow password hash would add nothing for a
+  random secret of that length.
+
+## Scopes
+
+| Scope | Allows |
+| --- | --- |
+| `reviews:read` | Listing and reading reviews |
+| `reviews:trigger` | Requesting a review |
+| `findings:read` | Reading findings and their context |
+| `findings:write` | Resolving findings with a note |
+| `codebase:read` | Searching the indexed codebase |
+| `rules:read` | Reading effective rules for a path |
+| `memories:read` | Reading review memories for a path |
+
+Every key has at least one scope. Unknown scopes are rejected.
+
+## Lifecycle
+
+- **Issue:** the plaintext token is returned once. Lifetime is at most one year.
+- **Rotate:** the new key keeps the name, scopes, and lifetime. The old key keeps
+  working for an overlap of up to seven days, then expires. A key can be rotated
+  only once.
+- **Revoke:** takes effect on the next request.
+
+Malformed, unknown, wrong, expired, revoked, and other-tenant keys all return
+the same `401 invalid API key`. A valid key without the required scope gets
+`403`.
+
+## Rate limits
+
+`RateLimiter` is a token bucket per key, with a configurable rate per minute and
+burst. A refused request gets `429` with `Retry-After`. The limiter is
+per-process, so with N API processes a key can make up to N × the rate. A
+cluster-wide limit needs a shared store.

+BEGIN;
+CREATE TABLE api_keys (
+    installation_id bigint NOT NULL REFERENCES installations(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
+    id text NOT NULL CHECK (id ~ '^[0-9a-f]{16}$'),
+    name text NOT NULL CHECK (length(name) BETWEEN 1 AND 100),
+    scopes text[] NOT NULL CHECK (cardinality(scopes) > 0 AND scopes <@ ARRAY['reviews:read', 'reviews:trigger', 'findings:read', 'findings:write', 'codebase:read', 'rules:read', 'memories:read']::text[]),
+    secret_sha256 bytea NOT NULL CHECK (length(secret_sha256) = 32),
+    created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
+    expires_at timestamptz NOT NULL,
+    revoked_at timestamptz,
+    replaced_by text,
+    PRIMARY KEY (installation_id, id),
+    FOREIGN KEY (installation_id, replaced_by) REFERENCES api_keys(installation_id, id),
+    CHECK (expires_at > created_at AND expires_at <= created_at + interval '366 days')
+);
+ALTER TABLE api_keys ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
+ALTER TABLE api_keys FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
+CREATE POLICY tenant_isolation ON api_keys USING (installation_id = current_setting('px1.installation_id', true)::bigint) WITH CHECK (installation_id = current_setting('px1.installation_id', true)::bigint);
+COMMIT;

explanations.title: Adds per-key rate limiting
explanations.summary: Requests are limited by key using a process-local token bucket with configurable refill rate and burst. When the bucket is empty, the middleware can return a wait duration for the Retry-After header.

explanations.title: Adds HTTP authentication and scope enforcement
explanations.summary: The HTTP middleware authenticates bearer tokens, enforces the required scope, and attaches the authenticated principal to the request context. It maps invalid keys to 401, missing scopes to 403, verification errors to 503, and rate-limit refusals to 429.

explanations.title: Adds digest-based key authentication
explanations.summary: Keys use a tenant ID and random key ID in the token, with a random secret whose SHA-256 digest is stored. Authentication checks the digest in constant time and rejects malformed, unknown, expired, or revoked keys with the same unauthorized error.

explanations.title: Validates issued keys and scopes
explanations.summary: Issuing a key now requires a valid tenant, non-empty name, at least one known scope, and a lifetime of no more than one year. Duplicate scopes are normalized before storage.

explanations.title: Adds key rotation and revocation
explanations.summary: Active keys can be rotated once, preserving their name and scopes while allowing the old key to work for a bounded overlap of up to seven days. Revoking a key makes subsequent authentication fail.

explanations.title: Adds tenant-isolated API key storage
explanations.summary: The new table stores key metadata and a fixed-length secret digest, constrains scopes and key IDs, and applies forced row-level security scoped to the current installation. The composite key and foreign key keep replacement relationships within a tenant.
